title: The Art of Fugue: Canon alla Ottava
video_use_ideas: Two-voice canon chase for a 'copy and follow' explainer.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 746 ('Die Kunst der Fuge, Contrapunctus XII - Canon alla Ottava', for Harpsichord, Piano); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Arnaud Gossart). Edition source: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1885. Mutopia labels this Contrapunctus XII (older numbering). Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
